title: Marketing Executive
description:
- Identify and develop new business opportunities for Cytogenetic and Molecular Genetic diagnostic services. 
 - Conduct regular field visits to hospitals, clinics, gynaecologists, oncologists, paediatricians, geneticists, infertility specialists and other relevant healthcare professionals to promote diagnostic services. 
 - Establish and maintain professional relationships with doctors, consultants, referral centres and healthcare institutions. 
 - Promote Cytogenetic investigations, including: - Karyotyping - FISH (Fluorescence In Situ Hybridisation) - Prenatal Cytogenetic Testing - Cancer Cytogenetic Studies - Other specialised chromosomal investigations. 
 - Promote Molecular Genetic investigations, including: - PCR and Real-Time PCR (qPCR) - DNA/RNA-based Molecular Diagnostics - Sanger Sequencing and Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) - Genetic Disorder and Carrier Screening - Prenatal Genetic Testing - Hereditary Cancer Testing - Pharmacogenetic Testing - Infectious Disease Molecular Diagnostics - Other specialised molecular investigations. 
 - Communicate test indications, clinical applications, methodologies, sample requirements and laboratory facilities to healthcare professionals. 
 - Coordinate with laboratory and sample collection teams to ensure appropriate sample collection, handling, transportation and processing. 
 - Generate referrals, develop new referral centres and achieve assigned business development and revenue targets. 
 - Maintain regular field visit reports, referral records and follow-up activities. 
 - Monitor market trends and competitor activities, gather feedback and identify business expansion opportunities. 
 - Coordinate with laboratory teams for timely communication and resolution of client queries. 
 - Participate in medical awareness programmes, CME activities, conferences and promotional events. 
 - Create awareness among healthcare professionals about advancements and clinical applications in Cytogenetics and Molecular Genetics.

Key Skills: Marketing,Healthcare Marketing,Healthcare,Medical
